question: What exact Gauss-physical reduction and source-charge constraints does the existing compact-U(1) rotor provide, and can they support a finite-local E8 current map?
summary_de: Der vorhandene kompakte U(1)-Rotor besitzt auf jedem endlichen zusammenhaengenden Graphen eine exakte, ganzzahlige Gauß-Reduktion mit Baumfluss und Zykluskoordinaten. Alle urspruenglichen Hoppings, CAR-Zeichen, Zustandsraeume und die gemeinsame Zeit bleiben erhalten; auf Zyklen bleibt das Winding ganzzahlig. Das ist eine positive Reduktion des gewaehlten Parents, aber keine QWZ-, Clock- oder P1/P2-Herleitung. In der bedingten E8-Quelle tragen die transportierten Wurzeln unter q=sum x die Ladungen 1,56,126,56,1 bei -4,-2,0,2,4; acht Cartanrichtungen sind neutral. Falls q mit der rotorischen Eichladung identifiziert wird und Bilder endlich-supportige Gauß-invariante Observablen sind, scheitert eine injektive Vollabbildung an 114 geladenen Stroemen. Als konstruktive Umkehr klassifiziert die volle E8-Neutralitaet alle kompatiblen ganzzahligen Covektoren als g=(v a,u,-3v); mit n-Neutralitaet und primitiver Normierung bleibt +/-K n. Reine und gemischte Bilineare mit q,Y verschwinden, die chirale Gravitationsanomalie bleibt jedoch offen, und g.n=0 waehrend g.z=2. Diese notwendige Ladungszuweisung ist weder im alten Gleichladungsrotor realisiert noch eine Eichfeld-, Kopplungs- oder Lueckenherleitung.
kills: Treat the known edge or square charge-dependent rotor energy as a new result without the prior provenance.
Replace integer cycle winding by a freely minimized real coordinate.
Identify the rotor gauged total charge with q and simultaneously map all 240 E8 currents to finite-support Gauss-invariant observables while ignoring the 114 charged currents.
Treat the compatible candidate g=+/-K n as an already realized gauge field, gauging, coupling, cosine term or gap.
Infer a QWZ/Clock source map, an E8 phase, a selected vacuum, or a fundamental interaction from the exact coordinate reduction alone.
assumptions: The unchanged two-species compact-U(1) parent and its declared local-window-round37 parameters
Finite connected graph, no external electric edges, integer link fluxes and the Gauss law B E=-(N-1)
A spanning tree and integral fundamental-cycle coordinates are bookkeeping choices, not new dynamics
The conditional ten-channel I_(9,1) source number q, hypercharge, glue and E8 lifts from the existing boundary contracts
The 114-current obstruction is conditional on identifying q with the rotor gauged total matter charge and requiring finite-support Gauss-invariant images
The constructive g classification uses the same lifted F(E8), n, q and Y data and is only a necessary charge-assignment test
leaves_open: A native QWZ-CAR to rotor field/operator map with common charge, grading and time
A charged-sector, boundary-dressed or extended algebra that could carry the nonneutral E8 currents
A source-derived local interaction selecting the E8 energy and phase
Realization of the candidate +/-K n charge in a microscopic source, including a gauge field, coupling and anomaly completion
A selected low-energy vacuum, many-body gap, infinite-volume limit and physical chiral 3+1D continuum
All T1-T8 physical closures and any promotion
not_claimed: No general impossibility theorem for fermions in gauge theories, charged sectors, nonlocal dressings or E8 extended algebras
No claim that the neutral 126-root sector is already E7 or E8 in the rotor
No general local-U(1) symmetry classification; only the reviewed limited onsite-class corollary is in scope
No claim that the candidate +/-K n charge is realized, gauged, coupled, cosine-pinned or gapped
No new interaction model, parameter tuning, selected state or Gaussian/non-Gaussian source theorem

source_pins.role: final exact reduction and charge gate
prior Gaussian closure and rotor commutator provenance
conditional ten-channel source and E8 dictionary
pinned n, z, hypercharge and source basis controls
original Gauss and parent operator implementation
complete finite edge/tree state and transfer provenance
prior square Hodge reduction and integer winding backreaction
Gauss convention and prior C6 lift scope

supplements.statement: A generator shift H -> H+lambda Q_g cannot remove the inherited charged quarter-holonomy or repair the fixed C/J mismatch on retained E8 root currents. The specified local odd c spinor families have charges +1/-1, while the bare critical z vertex has charge 2.
